title: Capital Group sells 1% stake in D-Mart for Rs 2,537 crore
description: Capital Group divested a 1.04 percent stake in Avenue Supermarts for Rs 2,537 crore. This significant open market transaction involved selling over 67 lakh equity shares of D-Mart's parent company. The shares were offloaded at an average price of Rs 3,750.58 per share. Avenue Supermarts' stock experienced a slight decline following the divestment announcement. The company recently reported an 11.33 percent rise in its June quarter net profit.

title: Fed seen a bit more likely to hike after inflation data
description: US inflation data showed a slight increase in July.  The personal consumption expenditures price index rose to 3.7 percent. Core inflation remained unchanged, indicating persistent underlying pressures.  This data strengthens the argument for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike.  Traders now anticipate a higher probability of a September rate increase.

title: US stocks today: US stocks subdued as hot inflation lifts rate hike bets ahead of Nvidia results
description: US stocks traded flat as investors awaited Nvidia's earnings and assessed hotter-than-expected inflation data. July inflation rose 3.7%, lifting bets on a September Fed rate hike. The Dow slipped 0.04%, while the S&P 500 edged up 0.03% and Nasdaq fell 0.06%, keeping markets cautious.

title: BSE, NSE impose over Rs 59 lakh penalty on NTPC, SJVN, REC for non-compliance
description: The BSE and NSE have imposed financial penalties exceeding Rs 59 lakh on three public sector power companies: NTPC, REC, and SJVN. The fines are due to violations related to board composition listing regulations. In their defense, the companies argue that the appointment of directors falls under presidential powers. They are currently seeking waivers for these penalties.
